skill.summary: Analyze Go error handling patterns — detect swallowed errors, missing error wrapping, sentinel vs custom error usage, type assertions, and idiomatic error pr...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Deep analyzer for Go error handling quality.

- Detects swallowed errors, missing error wrapping, non-idiomatic error patterns, and error propagation issues.
- Supports analysis of sentinel vs. custom errors, error test coverage, HTTP handler safety, and goroutine error handling.
- Prioritizes findings (Critical/Warning) with practical fix suggestions.
- Includes severity guidance, actionable output templates, and an error handling checklist aligned with Go best practices.
- Designed for reviewing Go codebases for production readiness and enforcing error conventions.
